source_base: client v8 candidate, not main product source
rustfmt: latest stable --check passed on both changed files

model_result.scope: Model only; no Rust compilation or runtime test.

changed_existing_control: cancelled_fire_grouping_retains_actual_accepted_records: three polls now reach the same grouping yield after two expiry walks are skipped
limitations: The nonsticky/no-expiry and ordered-deadline cases skip two queue-wide scans; these are conditional paths.
Vector prefix drains still shift the remaining records and can be quadratic.
Nonmonotonic deadlines can still cause repeated suffix scans; sticky queues still scan expiry.
A Python model checks its own abstraction and does not verify Rust lifetimes, execution, or timings.
The preexisting Worker contract restores an interrupted split during Drop; arbitrary resumption of that split is not qualified.
